findings.text: follow-on: the comment claims moved_in and moved_off are both read at the request's requirement, but only moved_off is requirement-filtered (snapshot.py:337-338); moved_in (snapshot.py:334) tallies every moved row in the 14-day window whatever the row recorded, so a move recorded once at a different requirement inflates the receiver's moved_in with no matching moved_off on the chooser.
